description:
Establish equivalent polynomial multiplication baselines. Establish reproducible operation-equivalent external baselines without changing production kernels.

## Background

Raw independent carry-less products, reduced field dot products and long binary-polynomial multiplication are different operations. The gf2x survey supplies honest polynomial comparisons without delaying the bounded raw-batch dispatch repair.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.

- [hard] REQ-02: Pin gf2x source, license, build configuration and exact operation, and establish its actually selected basecase and accelerated instructions from build/source/assembly evidence. Record blocked source access or unsupported configurations explicitly.

- [hard] REQ-03: Map existing wide polynomial/field consumers to unreduced or composed equivalent products, separating any field reduction. Validate coefficients, bit order, input lengths and complete outputs against canonical arithmetic; measure adapter/reduction overhead separately.

- [hard] REQ-04: Commit current baseline receipts and a frozen size/cache addendum for compatible polynomial cells. Retain raw independent-product batches as a separately labeled internal baseline unless a genuinely equivalent external arm is verified.

- [hard] REQ-05: Give gf2 and competitors equivalent host-targeting opportunities and report conservative/tuned/native distinctions. No gf2x production dependency or multiplication algorithm change is part of this survey.

## Notes

Pin exact source and build identities in the family addendum. Preserve unavailable, incompatible and losing arms rather than substituting a different operation.

Source references: [GfTwoX2026].
title: Establish equivalent polynomial multiplication baselines
